whatIs.heading: What is a family trip planner?
whatIs.definition: A family trip planner builds a schedule that works for everyone at once, including the people who need a nap, a toilet, or a break from museums.
whatIs.distinguish: The real constraint is pace, not places. A day that is comfortable alone becomes unworkable with a five-year-old, so the problem is fitting fewer stops with more slack, close enough together that nobody falls apart in transit.
whatIs.product: MonkeyTravel builds days around a pace you choose, with real places and the travel time between them, at three budget levels. Anything that does not suit your family can be swapped out.
whatIs.example: A morning museum, lunch nearby and an afternoon park is a real day. Three museums across town is a plan that reads well and ends in tears.
whatIs.honest: It does not know your children. Treat the pace as a starting point, and cut a stop whenever the day looks tight.

features.title: Everything Your Family Needs for the Perfect Trip
features.subtitle: Tell it about your family, then change whatever doesn't suit you. No hidden fees, no stress.

kidFriendly.title: Kid-Friendly Activities
kidFriendly.description: Choose Family under Who's coming? in step 1 and the plan leans towards parks, hands-on museums, casual places to eat and other things children enjoy. It's AI, so look over each stop.

ageAppropriate.title: Age-Appropriate Suggestions
ageAppropriate.description: Traveling with toddlers is different from traveling with teens. In step 2, open Customize and add your children's ages under Special Requirements, and the plan takes them into account.

familyBudget.title: Family Budget Management
familyBudget.description: Family trips add up fast. Choose Budget, Balanced or Premium and see an estimated cost for each stop. Check prices and children's rates before you book.

safeDestinations.title: Places You Can Check
safeDestinations.description: Open any stop to see its Google ratings and photos. You know your children best: tell the assistant what doesn't suit them and it changes the plan.

familySchedule.title: Balanced Family Schedules
familySchedule.description: No more over-packed days that lead to meltdowns. Choose a relaxed pace, add nap times under Special Requirements, and drop anything that looks like too much.

familyDining.title: Kid-Friendly Restaurants
familyDining.description: Ask for children's menus or high chairs under Special Requirements or in the chat, and the AI suggests places that fit. Call ahead to be sure.

howItWorks.title: Plan a Family Trip in 3 Simple Steps

step1.title: Enter Family Details
step1.description: Tell us your destination and travel dates, and choose Family under Who's coming?. Add your children's ages and what your family enjoys under Special Requirements. Beach lovers? History buffs? Theme park fans? Just say so.

step2.title: AI Builds Your Family Itinerary
step2.description: Our AI generates a complete day-by-day plan around what you told it, with places close together and realistic scheduling, all in under 60 seconds.

step3.title: Enjoy Your Trip Together
step3.description: Swap activities, adjust timing for nap schedules, and share the plan with your partner. Less planning stress, more family fun.

whatAges.question: What ages does the family trip planner support?
whatAges.answer: Any age. In step 2, open Customize and add each child's age under Special Requirements, and the AI takes it into account, from stroller-friendly walks to adventure activities for teens. It doesn't know your children, so look over the plan.

isFree.question: Is the family trip planner free?
isFree.answer: Yes, MonkeyTravel is completely free for families. Create family itineraries, share plans with your partner, and plan across multiple budget tiers — all without paying anything or entering a credit card.

howSafe.question: Do you check that activities are safe for kids?
howSafe.answer: We don't check places for safety or for children, so look over anything you're unsure about. You can open Google's ratings and photos for any stop, and ask the assistant to swap whatever doesn't suit your family.

specialNeeds.question: Can I plan for children with dietary needs or allergies?
specialNeeds.answer: Yes. You can specify dietary requirements and the AI will prioritize restaurants that accommodate allergies and special diets. We recommend confirming directly with restaurants before your visit for the most up-to-date information.

multiFamily.question: Can I plan a trip with multiple families?
multiFamily.answer: Absolutely. MonkeyTravel includes group collaboration tools — invite other families via link, vote on activities together, and build a shared itinerary that works for everyone.

destinations.question: What family-friendly destinations do you support?
destinations.answer: MonkeyTravel plans family trips for any city worldwide, from Orlando and Barcelona to Tokyo, London and Rome.
